logistics.pickle_name_dataset: Name of the pickle object that will contain the CMU-MOSEI mmdataset
logistics.root_data_folder: Name of the root folder where data processed by this repository is stored
logistics.round_decimals: Number of decimals to be rounded for metrics
logistics.plot_confusion_matrix: Whether we plot and save confusion matrices with pickle (0 or 1)
logistics.save_predictions: Whether we save predictions with pickle (0 or 1)
logistics.display_fig: Whether we display the figures from the terminal (0 or 1)
logistics.num_training_prints: Number of prints for each epoch (only for PyTorch)

task.model_name: Name of the model to be tested (check README.md for the list of possible models)
task.label_type: Type of labels used for model training and evaluation. Possible values: all, coarse, present, dominant (check README.md for more details). For multitask, list of two elements.
task.set_length: Fixed length for sequence data (padding/truncate, using avg, max, or int>0) OR keep variable length (set 'none', only for Pytorch). Possible values: 'avg', 'max', any strictly positive number, 'none'.
task.thres_score_pres: Threshold at which emotions are considered to be present. Must be between 0 and 3. Note that setting thresholds greater than 0 might lead to no positive true and predicted classes and skew classification metrics (F1, precision, recall).
task.predict_neutral_class: Whether we predict the neutral class (0 or 1). Only useful for label_type 'present' or 'dominant.
task.align_to_text: Whether audio and image data are aligned to the textual modality (0 or 1)
task.image_feature: Image features. Values: facet or openface.
task.thres_nan: Percentage threshold (between 0 and 1) of NaN/inf above which the sample is withdrawn
task.replace_nan: Method for replacing NaN and/or infinite values, among 'mean' (mean value along the column), 'linear_2d' (which perform 2D linear interpolation when applicable then nearest neighbor), 'linear_1d' (same but for each feature column)
task.with_custom_split: Whether we perform custom split on training and validation sets (0 or 1). For more details, cf. Williams et al. (2018) paper.

training.val_metrics: Validation metric used for monitoring (callbacks like EarlyStopping, ReduceLROnPlateau), -1 if using F1 as validation metrics for 'present' and 'dominant' tasks
training.coef_coa: Weight of the coarse task (when use multitask-specific loss_function/val_metric)
training.thres_ml_from_best_metric: For multilabel classification ('present', 'dominant'), 1 if take the class-wise threshold that gives the best F1 score on validation set, 0 to set all thresholds to 0.5. No effect for the other task types.
training.cross_val_folds: Number of folds for cross-validation (-1 if parameter not used)
training.clip: Gradient clip value (-1 if parameter not used)
training.when: When to decay learning rate (-1 if parameter not used)

ef_williams.num_nodes: Number nodes for the penultimate dense layer

ef_williams_debug.num_nodes: Number nodes for the penultimate dense layer

late_fusion.num_nodes: Number nodes for the penultimate dense layer

mult.num_heads: Number of heads for the transformer network
